decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line changelog entry: "fix(controller): wrong tracking annotation for malformed resources (#22325)" [ev-9fdf3ef2828b]. It doesn't say what counts as a "malformed" resource or what the wrong annotation was. It also doesn't say whether the problem can be seen in manifests, which would allow a static check, or only shows up at runtime. So the evidence can't confirm the proposed undecidable/runtime-behavior-gap condition or any narrower predicate. To decide this, we need the PR #22325 description or diff that defines "malformed" and explains when the wrong tracking annotation was applied.
